lessons.statement: In discovery the scenario invalidation is a SCORING line, not a stop — commit it BELOW the liquidity pool (recent swing-low / liq-cluster / round number), not above it. Placing it above the pool lets a stop-hunt sweep score a correct reversal call as wrong.
lessons.test: Among calls scored WRONG, the fraction swept-then-right (dn tagged, up reached anyway within h). >=40% over >=5 wrong calls => break-lines wrong-sided => promote. calibration.py prints this as the SWEEP DIAGNOSTIC.

evidence.seed_note: Collector liq-map 2026-08-15 (tick-20260815-1818) showed a BTC long-liq cluster ~62,430 BELOW call #1's dn=62,600 — the wrong-sided break that motivated L1.

lessons.proposed_doctrine: In discovery, the invalidation is a SCORING line (no stops in discovery): commit it BELOW the liquidity pool. A hunt that wicks the pool and reverses to target scores as the correct call it was.
